name: Session Usage
description: Slash command /usage for the current session: uncached input, cache hit/create, output and hit rate.
author: LectWolf
changelog:
1.0.0 first public release
- Add /usage for this session: uncached input, cache hit/create, output, reasoning and hit rate
- Add a custom session picker with instant title search
- Add Claude cache-create (5m / 1h) and a last-reply card
- Refresh on window focus without wiping search or scroll
safetyNotes: Reads only local PI-Desktop usage metadata. No network, no message text, no agent tools.

en.name: Session Usage
en.description: Slash command /usage for the current session: uncached input, cache hit/create, output and hit rate.
en.safetyNotes: Reads only local PI-Desktop usage metadata (session jsonl usage fields and completed-turn tokens in pi.sqlite). Does not read message text, does not register agent tools, and never sends data off-device.

zh-CN.name: 会话用量
zh-CN.description: 在输入框输入 /usage，查看当前会话的输入、输出、缓存命中、缓存创建和命中率。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读取本机 PI-Desktop 的用量元数据（会话 jsonl 的 usage 字段和 pi.sqlite 已完成回合的 token）。不读消息正文、不注册 Agent 工具、不联网。
zh-CN.changelog:
1.0.0 首次公开发布
- 新增 /usage：当前会话的输入、缓存命中/创建、输出、思考和命中率
- 新增会话选择器，按标题即时搜索
- 新增 Claude 缓存创建（5m / 1h）和最近一轮卡片
- 窗口重新获得焦点时刷新，搜索和滚动位置会保留
